ask: Keep the grey badge for counts that cannot load, or leave the badge as it was?
problem: The Inbox badge is the usual corner indicator. When the web page loses its link to the server, it quietly shows nothing, so it can say nothing is waiting when that is untrue.
found: You read it right: the badge is standard. The fault is the link. The page could not renew its sign-in, so count requests failed, and the badge hid it. A live feed would fail the same way. Code only; no live logs.
changed: Only how the badge fails: a count that cannot refresh keeps its last number in grey, or shows a grey dot. It retries after 15 seconds. Nothing else changes.
why: Renewal fails when the network drops or is busy, and the app already retries. There is no bigger fix to make here. An expired sign-in is LAN-243's. Pictures are drawings, not screenshots.
touches: Screen readers keep the old label. The My Work bell changes the same way.

options.label: Keep the grey badge
options.result: A badge that cannot refresh turns grey, and retries soon. Honest, small change.

options.label: Leave the badge as it was
options.result: No change. The badge may show nothing while the link is down. I close the pull request.
